s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain with weight loss and gastrointestinal symptoms
key_facts: Medical history of chronic kidney disease
Pain associated with nausea, vomiting, and acid reflux
No history of significant alcohol or substance use
Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration on ultrasound
Positive Doppler flow within the subcapsular hepatic lesion

shortlist.label: Metastatic melanoma to the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Immunostaining results positive for human melanoma black-45, smooth muscle actin, and melanoma antigen recognized by T cells 1 (melan-A) suggest metastatic melanoma

shortlist.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated lipase level and liver biopsy showing islands of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm are consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma

shortlist.label: Hepatic epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Subcapsular enhancing lesion on MRI and positive Doppler flow within the subcapsular hepatic lesion are suggestive of a vascular tumor such as hepatic epithelioid hemangioendothelioma

shortlist.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Echogenic liver parenchyma with fatty infiltration and a single hypoechoic lesion on ultrasound are consistent with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Hepatic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Liver biopsy showing islands of neoplastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm and the presence of a subcapsular enhancing lesion on MRI are also consistent with hepatic adenoma

raw.rationale: The patient's immunostaining results showed positivity for human melanoma black-45, smooth muscle actin, and melanoma antigen recognized by T cells 1 (melan-A), which are specific markers for melanoma, and negativity for hepatocyte-specific markers, supporting the diagnosis of metastatic melanoma to the liver.

rejected.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: Immunostaining results were negative for hepatocyte paraffin 1 and other hepatocyte-specific markers, making this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Hepatic epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: The presence of eosinophilic cytoplasm and specific melanoma markers do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
rejected.why: The immunostaining profile does not match that expected for cholangiocarcinoma, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with metastatic disease

rejected.label: Hepatic adenoma
rejected.why: The presence of malignant-appearing cells and specific melanoma markers on immunostaining make this benign diagnosis unlikely

gold: Perivascular endothelial carcinoma (PEComa) of the liver
